The `/bedTag` endpoint is called from both the O3 bed management app and the legacy OWA. The O3 calls are in `summary.resource.ts`. The OWA calls are in three components. Two e2e helpers also hit it, but they aren't app code.

**O3 bed management app** (`openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-bed-management-app`)
- `useBedTags` does a GET on `${restBaseUrl}/bedTag/` through SWR: `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-bed-management-app/src/summary/summary.resource.ts:215-234`
- `saveBedTag` does a POST to `/bedTag/`: `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-bed-management-app/src/summary/summary.resource.ts:249-259`
- `editBedTag` does a POST to `/bedTag/${bedTagId}`: `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-bed-management-app/src/summary/summary.resource.ts:275-287`
- `deleteBedTag` does a DELETE to `/bedTag/${bedTagId}?reason=...`: `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-bed-management-app/src/summary/summary.resource.ts:289-293`

**Legacy OWA** (`openmrs-module-bedmanagement/owa/app/components/bedTag`)
- `fetchBedTags` does a GET on `/bedTag` with `v=full`: `openmrs-module-bedmanagement/owa/app/components/bedTag/bedTagWrapper.js:46-63`
- The add/edit form POSTs to `/bedTag` or `/bedTag/<uuid>`: `openmrs-module-bedmanagement/owa/app/components/bedTag/bedTagForm/addEditBedTag.js:41-66`
- The list row DELETEs `/bedTag/<uuid>`: `openmrs-module-bedmanagement/owa/app/components/bedTag/bedTagList/bedTagListRow.js:17-41`

**Not app code, but will need updating on a rename**
- E2E helper `generateBedTag` POSTs to `/openmrs/ws/rest/v1/bedTag`: `openmrs-esm-patient-management/e2e/commands/bed-operations.ts:105-114`
- E2E spec waits for a POST response whose URL includes `/bedTag`: `openmrs-esm-patient-management/e2e/specs/bed-administration-create-bed.spec.ts:40-46`
- OWA Jest tests mock `/bedTag` URLs: `openmrs-module-bedmanagement/owa/app/components/__tests__/bedTag/bedTagWrapper-test.js:65`, `openmrs-module-bedmanagement/owa/app/components/__tests__/bedTag/addEditBedTag-test.js:34`

The server-side resource that defines the endpoint is `openmrs-module-bedmanagement/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/bedmanagement/rest/resource/BedTagResource.java:40`. The `bedTagMap` calls in `bed-form.resource.ts` are a separate resource and are not included.
